review_note: Exact candidate snapshot, NOT independent review approval. Separate spec and standards reviewers must review these complete before/after sources and all guarded hashes. Any product drift fails closed and requires regeneration plus fresh review.

build_workflow.staged_signing_before:
- name: Stable production signing and verification
        env:
          ELCTON_KEYSTORE_B64: ${{ secrets.ELCTON_KEYSTORE_B64 }}
          ELCTON_SIGN_PASS: ${{ secrets.ELCTON_SIGN_PASS }}
          EXPECTED_SIGN_SHA256: ${{ secrets.ELCTON_CERT_SHA256 }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -n "$ELCTON_KEYSTORE_B64"
          test -n "$ELCTON_SIGN_PASS"
          test -n "$EXPECTED_SIGN_SHA256"
          mkdir -p dist
          printf '%s' "$ELCTON_KEYSTORE_B64" | base64 --decode > "$RUNNER_TEMP/elcton.jks"
          BT="$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools/34.0.0"
          "$BT/zipalign" -f 4 app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk "$RUNNER_TEMP/aligned.apk"
          "$BT/apksigner" sign --ks "$RUNNER_TEMP/elcton.jks" --ks-key-alias elcton --ks-pass env:ELCTON_SIGN_PASS --key-pass env:ELCTON_SIGN_PASS --out dist/elcton-phone-probe.apk "$RUNNER_TEMP/aligned.apk"
          "$BT/zipalign" -f 4 app/build/outputs/apk/androidTest/debug/app-debug-androidTest.apk "$RUNNER_TEMP/test-aligned.apk"
          "$BT/apksigner" sign --ks "$RUNNER_TEMP/elcton.jks" --ks-key-alias elcton --ks-pass env:ELCTON_SIGN_PASS --key-pass env:ELCTON_SIGN_PASS --out dist/elcton-ui-tests.apk "$RUNNER_TEMP/test-aligned.apk"
          "$BT/apksigner" verify --print-certs dist/elcton-phone-probe.apk > dist/apk-signature.txt
          "$BT/apksigner" verify --print-certs dist/elcton-ui-tests.apk > dist/test-signature.txt
          python3 -c 'import os,re,pathlib; s=pathlib.Path("dist/apk-signature.txt").read_text(); m=re.search(r"certificate SHA-256 digest: ([0-9a-fA-F]+)",s); assert m and m.group(1).lower()==os.environ["EXPECTED_SIGN_SHA256"].lower(), "Signing identity mismatch"'
          python3 qa/p2p-ready-20261114/verify_apk_candidate.py dist/elcton-phone-probe.apk dist/candidate-manifest.json
          rm "$RUNNER_TEMP/elcton.jks"
          printf '%s\n' "$GITHUB_SHA" > dist/source-sha.txt
